content.description:
We admired what Hosky was (not) doing for the Cardano ecosystem and felt we could make it even worse.

Welcome to Hosky Inu - the deepfried, dystopian, copy-pasta meme coin we totally don’t need but definitely deserve. We promise everything Hosky has to offer but far, far less. Not interested? Keep reading!

We have nothing to do until real DeFi hits Cardano. Let’s embrace this golden window of the Cardano brown coin era.

Let’s go.

Siberian Husky and Shiba Inu mixes actually do exist. And they’re super cute. They’re labeled as a ‘designer breed’, which is totally gross, and also something you’ll never be able afford with your Hosky Inu. But you don’t care, because you’re a degenerate and designer meme coins at zero value are somehow important right now. Who wants to be new rich when you can be future poor?

This is where it gets good. While Hosky minted a paltry 1 quadrillion tokens (lame), we’ve done the noble thing and made the supply of Hosky Inu 1000x larger.

Total Supply: 1000000000000000000

Look at those zeros - bring the screen closer to your face until your eyes get a bit wet. Emotion or confusion? Exactly.
